mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS imgId, e.url, e.sha_256 AS sha256, ue.sort FROM user_emoji ue INNER JOIN emoji e ON ue.emoji_id = e.id WHERE ue.uid = #{uid} AND ue.delete_status = 0 ORDER BY ue.sort ASC, ue.emoji_id ASC

SELECT ue.id, ue.uid, ue.emoji_id, ue.sort, ue.delete_status FROM user_emoji ue INNER JOIN emoji e ON ue.emoji_id = e.id WHERE ue.uid = #{uid} AND ue.delete_status = 0 ORDER BY ue.sort ASC, ue.emoji_id ASC LIMIT 1
